rows.en: What power!! I never thought Eleking would be this strong...!!
It's coming this way!!
Kiiiiiiiiiih!!
OOO! Zero! Now we've got no choice but to fight. Let's combine the strength of all three of us!!
Yeah!!
The gap in power is way too big!!
We can't even scratch it...
Something's wrong...!!
Forget Emerium Slash, I can't even use my Zero Sluggers!!
...Let's fall back for now.
I hate to admit it... but the way we are now, it doesn't look like we can beat this thing...
Kiiiiiiiiiiih!!
Hah... hah... We should be safe now that we've come this far...
Something's strange... about the way we're wearing out.
But I've figured it out. The enemy didn't get stronger...
We're the ones who've lost our power.
So it seems.
I couldn't pull off my "Tatoba Kick" either.
...Hm? What's that...?
A hole in space...?
...Looks like a rift in space-time.
A rift in space-time...?
Yeah. Some of the enemies I've fought before came from other dimensions.
Other dimensions...? That's hard to believe, but if it's true, are there enemies in there?
No... but somehow, I feel strangely calm...
Look, from the other side of the hole... Can't you feel it?
...You're right. What is this? This feels so nostalgic...
That's it...!!
Maybe what's beyond here connects back to our own world!!
Let's find out.
You're right. Let's go! Into the hole!
The three of them leapt into the hole that had opened in space.
Where are we...?
Looks like a catapult deck... though it's not the Ra Cailum or the Argama...
I've never seen a place like this before.
...Hey! All that damage we took is gone like it never happened!!
...Hm? ...My body suddenly feels lighter, too.
Ah... Me too! My wounds healed before I even noticed!!
I don't know why, but since coming here, everyone's strength recovered in no time.
Yeah. This place is clearly different from where we just were.
That said, it doesn't seem to be our own world either...
But there's no sign of any enemies here at all!!
Now that you mention it, you're right!!
(Where am I...?)
(Why am I in a place like this...?)
A powerful enemy blocks the way! At this rate, a battle looks unavoidable.
...I see. So this is where all of you have made your base.
Even so, it looks like all sorts of things have been gathered up here.
But most of it has stopped working.
I see... Some of it looks usable, though...
What's this...? Mebius, isn't this an Archive?
Mebius, isn't this an Archive?
You're right... It's the GUYS Archive Document!
What's that?
It's a file of data on kaiju and aliens.
Then it's got data on Seamons and Seagorath too?
I'm searching now...
A lot of these files are corrupted... That one was... MAT... Found it!!
Found it!!
Document MAT, Register Code: "Seamons", "Seagorath"!
Oh!! Alright!!
Do they have any kind of weakness?
It says that when MAT's new weapon broke their horns, they lost their special powers!
That's it!
So their weak spot is the horns...
Alright! Let's go!!
Wait! Let's split up the roles before we go.
Let's split up the roles before we go.
Mebius and I will go ahead and attack their horns.
Once the storm stops, you all use that opening to get in close and hit them hard in one go.
I see. Not bad.
Leave it to us!!
Right, then we'll go on ahead. Let's go, Mebius!
Let's go, Mebius!
We'll head out too, as soon as we're ready.
{8074} and the others returned to base.
Hikari was carried back to base and focused on recovering in the medical room...
...And then

notes.note: Eleking roar; no established English for this roar in the glossary style list. Used the Kii...ih!! pattern (Birdon/Pandon); 0.27 is one letter longer to mirror the longer source. story_178 has the same creature's roar - harmonise if it chose differently.
Not played by event 0990 (script jumps from +15 to +24); speaker unrecovered. Casual reply to Nu Gundam's call to OOO and Zero, likely Zero. Kept neutral.
0.19-0.21 are unscripted in 0990 and match the battle-event table MainEventMess0015 (in-battle quips, speaker unknown). Subject 'we' restored in 0.20. 0.22 is clearly Zero (his techniques).

0.25-0.35 are not played by event 0991 (script ends at narration +22); speakers inferred from content: 0.26 Nu Gundam (Amuro's ships), 0.27 OOO (polite, though it uses boku), 0.28 Zero, 0.29 Nu Gundam, 0.30 OOO, 0.31 Nu Gundam, 0.32 Zero, 0.33 likely Nu Gundam, 0.34 OOO, 0.35 Zero. English is speaker-neutral.
Script 0999 plays +0 with no name label while only Zero is loaded; treated as Zero's thought (followed by Zero's 0.7).
0.6, 0.13, 0.22, 0.28 are unused alt copies (script skips them); translated to match their full versions. Phrasing kept consistent with the earlier parallel scene in story_006 (MainEventMess0114).
Zero speaks for the strike team ('us') answering Hikari's plan.
0902 rows 0.1-0.4 play with no name label: narration / silent beat.

report: All 80 rows examined; speakers verified against event scripts 0990/0991/0999/0901/0902 (all extracted labels correct). Unscripted rows (0990 0.17-0.21, 0991 0.25-0.35, 0901 alt copies) voiced from content. Eleking roar spelling not in glossary style list.
